title: Salesforce Acquires Braze for $5.66B to Scale Agentforce AI

tickers.name: Braze, Inc. Class A Common Stock

summary:
A cash payout of $47.50 per share of Class A common stock will be delivered to Braze shareholders under a new definitive acquisition agreement with Salesforce. The deal values the customer engagement platform at approximately $5.66 billion in enterprise value, bringing real-time engagement technology into the sales and marketing cloud provider's ecosystem.

The transaction absorbs a competitor that had been poaching clients from Salesforce's own Marketing Cloud. The integration allows the company's Agentforce AI to act on live customer behavior and introduces a usage-based revenue model as the rise of AI agents challenges traditional per-seat software pricing.

Salesforce Signs Definitive Agreement to Acquire Braze

"Salesforce (NYSE: $CRM), the world’s #1 AI CRM, today announced it has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Braze (NASDAQ: $BRZE), a leading customer engagement platform, for approximately $5.66 billion in enterprise value. Under the terms of the agreement, holders of Braze Class A common stock will receive $47.50 in cash per share."
